title: IAM Identity Center and federation with an identity provider

videos.script: The shop has six accounts and five people. Give each person a user in each account, and you have thirty users to create, audit and delete. {{grid}} This lesson replaces all thirty with one sign-in. {{center}} IAM Identity Center keeps people outside the accounts. A permission set says what a kind of access means, once, for the whole organisation. An assignment joins three things: a group, a permission set and one account. {{roles}} When you make an assignment, Identity Center creates a role inside that account. A person who opens the account is assuming that role, for a few hours, with their own name on the session. {{idp}} The people themselves can live somewhere you already run, like Google Workspace or Entra ID. SAML carries the sign-in. SCIM carries the list of who exists. {{moto}} You will build the permission sets, the groups and the assignments in moto, and measure the one step it leaves out. {{cli}} Then you will write the profile that lets the command line sign in the same way, without a key in any file. {{end}}
